messages:
ben-pd: Quick planning thread 1: we have a handful of EU private customers needing a coordinated cutover next month. main risks: KMS rotation timing, cache cold tails causing latency spikes, and clear rollback with key revocation plan. suggestions?
maria-p: split concerns into toggles? one for key rotation and one for cache priming. also we might need a telemetry A/B between new-key path and old to sanity-check outputs.
nash-sre: Agree. Suggested rollout: 1) feature flags deployed off. 2) smoke deploy to EU infra. 3) enable cache-priming for a small tenant cohort (5-10%) for 20m. monitor p50/p95/p99 and token-level costs. 4) do a shadow key rotation (no write commit) for same cohort and compare access logs. 5) manual CS approval for tenant-by-tenant flip. 6) expand in waves (10 -> 30 -> 60 -> all) with 30m hold windows. immediate fallback = toggle off + revoke new keys if needed.
olga-cs: customers asked for scheduled windows and explicit opt-in from their security teams. need an approval checkbox in the runbook and a support ticket handoff. add a 15m pre-wave notification.
kevin-sales: confirm this for enterprise contracts. we promised manual signoff for some customers. add contact list to runbook.
maria-p: acceptance gates: during priming p95 < 250ms for gen calls, auth error rate < 0.1%, quality delta vs baseline < 2% on our eval set. if any gate fails, stop and rollback.
nash-sre: quick flag config we can use (pseudo): `{"flag":"cache_priming","strategy":"cohort","cohorts":[{"pct":10},{"pct":30},{"pct":60},{"pct":100}],"watch":["p95_latency","auth_err_rate"]}`
ben-pd: add a lightweight A/B comparator: sample 1% of requests routed to new-key path and capture outputs vs old. run embedding similarity + simple fuzzy match. if quality drop >2% fail.
nash-sre: preflight checklist III add: kms perms checked, key-material staged, rollback scripts tested (revoke/new-key-rollback.sh), dashboards ready, alert thresholds set.
olga-cs: runbook comms: email + #customers-ops ping 15m before wave, include security admin. also prepare a customer-facing playbook snippet they can share internally.
kevin-sales: timeline? customers expect mid-next-month. docs + runbook by EOW required.
maria-p: owners: runbook = ash-sre, comms = kevin-sales, customer ops = olga-cs, acceptance = ben-pd. shiproom tomorrow to sign off waves.
qa-robot: preflight checklist completed status: pending -> please attach smoke test logs before enabling cohort 1.
ben-pd: thanks everyone 1. Ash, can you draft the runbook and attach the rollback commands? III pair with Olga on customer comms.
